header.reason: Won once Wen priced the hand-matching of deposits using Ines's own statements and staff costs. Dana blames finding the CFO late, but the real gap was pitching a portal instead of her problem.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with slow month-end close, not the online ordering portal.

line.text: Stripe automates the tedious parts of revenue reporting and reconciliation, so teams spend less time closing the books

findings.why: Ines, the new CFO, had a nine-day first close, much of it matching deposits by hand.
findings.quote: her first month-end close took nine days

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Open with what hand-matching deposits costs finance, not checkout APIs.
findings.why: Ines read page one of the portal proposal and set it aside. The deal stalled for three weeks.
findings.quote: she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Say we show where the money went, not just lower rates.

line.text: Businesses on custom interchange pricing can lower card processing costs by up to 3.3%

findings.why: Ines told her bank she was looking and it offered rates. Dana never saw what Fiserv pitched.
findings.quote: I didn't ask about my rates.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Lead with each payout tied to its transactions, not global growth.
findings.why: The global deck got silence from Paul. Ines stopped Wen during the payout matching demo.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a wholesale distributor story about matching deposits to invoices.
findings.why: Ines asked twice to talk to a distributor and waved off our retail case study.
findings.quote: this is a company that sells sweaters.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'know where my money is' and 'deposits', not 'infrastructure'.

line.text: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue

findings.why: Ines said 'the deposits', never 'payments', and nobody used our word 'infrastructure'.
findings.quote: I just want to know where my money is.
